text: With n=4 right-hand bars, the Riemann sum overshoots the integral of x squared, and the error readout is large. Predict what doubling will do.
At n=8 the bars hug the curve more closely, and the error readout drops. Compare with your prediction before the final refinement.
At n=16 the bars nearly fill the area under the curve, the error is smallest, and the ending is clean with nothing left behind.
